# DSH ChatGPT Adapter

> A community MIT plugin that adds ChatGPT subscription models to DeepSeek Harness desktop 0.2.0-rc.2, while keeping DeepSeek selectable.

Canonical documentation: https://diwer.github.io/dsh-codex-adapter/
Package: dsh-codex-official-adapter. Current usage release: 0.1.0. Not affiliated with OpenAI or DeepSeek. Model availability depends on the user's authorized account.

## Documentation

- [Source repository](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter)
- [Download release](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/releases/tag/v0.1.0)
- [Privacy and credentials](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY.md)
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md)

- [Market coverage](https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/blob/main/docs/MARKET_PUBLISHING.md)
- [Full plain-text documentation](https://diwer.github.io/dsh-codex-adapter/llms-full.txt)

## Boundaries

Installation is validated on macOS desktop 0.2.0-rc.2. Older Web hosts and other platforms are not implied compatible. Marketplace listing and AI-search indexing must be checked separately; neither is guaranteed by this file. Credentials are plaintext local files with restrictive permissions.
